title: From Reasoning to Action: Benchmarking Frontier AI Models on LIBERO-10 Robot Manipulation Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.30051v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in frontier AI models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, planning, and tool use, raising the possibility of using general-purpose AI models for robot manipulation without task-specific training. However, their manipulation capabilities have not been systematically evaluated on standardized robotics benchmarks. In this report, we present a unified closed-loop manipulation framework for evaluating frontier AI models on the LIBERO-10 benchmark. Our framework enables models to control a robot directly through visual observations, robot proprioception, and structured tool calls, primarily by specifying target end-effector poses and gripper commands, without task-specific fine-tuning or pretrained manipulation skills. translated_title: 从推理到行动：在前沿AI模型上对LIBERO-10机器人操作任务进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 近年来，前沿AI模型在视觉理解、推理、规划和工具使用方面展现出卓越的能力，这引发了在不进行任务特定训练的情况下将通用AI模型用于机器人操作的可能性。然而，这些模型的操作能力尚未在标准化的机器人学基准上进行系统性评估。在本报告中，我们提出了一个统一的闭环操作框架，用于在LIBERO-10基准上评估前沿AI模型。我们的框架使模型能够通过视觉观察、机器人本体感觉和结构化工具调用来直接控制机器人，主要通过指定目标末端执行器位姿和夹爪命令来实现，无需任务特定的微调或预训练的操作技能。我们评估了六个前沿AI模型，包括GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Luna、Claude Opus 5、Claude Opus 5.5和Gemini-4 Argon，并在三种推理努力水平下进行了测试。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的闭环操作评估框架，无需任务特定微调即可在LIBERO-10基准上系统性评估六个前沿AI模型直接控制机器人执行操作任务的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a unified closed-loop manipulation framework for systematically benchmarking six frontier AI models on LIBERO-10 robot manipulation tasks without task-specific fine-tuning or pretrained manipulation skills.
